snippet.title: Clean Tides — Official Trailer | Cozy Ocean Cleanup Game
snippet.description:
Set sail for a cleaner ocean in Clean Tides, a cozy ocean cleanup game from lil kooky. Collect floating trash, help marine wildlife, upgrade your boat, and bring coral reefs back to life.

Discover Clean Tides on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5355540/Clean_Tides/

Subscribe to lil kooky for official trailers, gameplay previews, and development updates.
